name: fluid-ds
description: Fluid Design System, framework-agnostic web components

scripts.dev: concurrently --names landing,storybook,playground,docs,demos,wizard --prefix-colors blue,cyan,magenta,yellow,green,red --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/landing dev" "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/storybook dev:open" "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/playground dev:open" "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/docs dev:open" "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/demos dev:open" "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/wizard dev:open"
scripts.check:docs: pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/docs build && pnpm test:docs-links && pnpm check:docs-links
scripts.check:cem: node --test scripts/cem/canonical.test.mjs scripts/cem/publication.test.mjs scripts/cem/owned-node.test.mjs && node scripts/cem/generate.mjs --check
scripts.test:all: pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:a11y && pnpm test:ssr-browser && pnpm test:ssr-request-time
scripts.check:quality: node scripts/check-quality.mjs --check && node --test scripts/check-certification-scope.test.mjs scripts/check-localization-owned-strings.test.mjs scripts/interaction-contracts.test.mjs scripts/ssr-state-adoption-inventory.test.mjs apps/a11y/scripts/severity-disposition.test.mjs && node scripts/check-certification-scope.mjs && node scripts/check-localization-owned-strings.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm check:coverage && pnpm check:quality && pnpm check:cem && pnpm test:release-gates && pnpm test:package-artifacts && pnpm test:framework:isolation && pnpm test:framework:guards && pnpm test:browser-selection && pnpm test:browser-command-ownership && pnpm test:browser-policy && pnpm test:browser-lifecycle && pnpm test:coverage-inventory && pnpm check:tokens && pnpm test:matrix && pnpm build && pnpm check:ssr && pnpm check:docs
scripts.test:interactions: pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/storybook build && concurrently -k -s first "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/storybook exec http-server storybook-static -p 6006 --silent" "pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/storybook exec wait-on http://127.0.0.1:6006 && pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/storybook test:runner && pnpm --filter @fluid-ds/storybook exec test-storybook --url http://127.0.0.1:6006 --includeTags interaction-contract --failOnConsole"
scripts.verify:release: pnpm verify && pnpm test:ssr-node && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:packed && pnpm check:cem:packed && pnpm check:performance && pnpm test:interactions
scripts.test:packed: pnpm test:package-artifacts && pnpm build && node scripts/check-package-artifacts.mjs --install
scripts.test:release-gates: node --test scripts/release-gates.test.mjs scripts/dry-run-publish.test.mjs scripts/check-supply-chain.test.mjs scripts/check-dependency-risk.test.mjs scripts/dependency-remediation.test.mjs
scripts.test:framework:guards: node packages/react/scripts/check-generated.mjs && node --test scripts/framework-runtime.test.mjs scripts/framework-packing.test.mjs scripts/framework-pinned-profile.test.mjs scripts/framework-commands.test.mjs scripts/framework-docs.test.mjs scripts/check-framework-next-request-time.test.mjs packages/react/scripts/event-props.test.mjs packages/react/scripts/generated-output.test.mjs
